problems: Only hotels that hotels.com labels as Miyajima (the island) were counted: 7 qualified (3 to 4 stars, 8+, 30+ reviews). Hotels with Miyajima in their name that are on the mainland at Miyajimaguchi were left out, for example Grandvrio Hotel Miyajima Wakura (address Miyajimaguchinishi; 3.5 stars, 9.2, 922 reviews, $117 nightly and $133 total on its page, free parking) and HOTEL FORK & KNIFE Miyajima (4 stars, 9.8, 31 reviews). Several other island hotels were left out for fewer than 30 reviews. Miyajima Kinsuikan is 4.5 stars so was excluded. hotels.com stops listing at 100 results, so the list was read in both price orders. Prices are USD for a signed-in account, rewards off on detail pages.
